block.name: Slot Guard CC
block.doc:
Slot-level guard for USRP/host time drift. The block:
- splits the stream into slots of "Samples per slot", - reads host time and USRP time once per slot, - computes a sliding-window jitter on the offset, - decides per slot among: PASS, DTX_ZEROS, DONT_CONSUME
using two sets of thresholds:
1) PASS region: - |offset_s| < Offset PASS thr (s) - jitter_s < Jitter PASS thr (s) => slot is passed as-is.
2) DONT_CONSUME region (severe drift): - |offset_s| >= Offset DONT thr (s) OR - jitter_s >= Jitter DONT thr (s) AND host is ahead (offset_s < -Offset DONT thr) AND "Allow DONT_CONSUME (host leads)" is True => slot enters DONT_CONSUME: the block does not consume input nor produce output, creating backpressure so that upstream timing can re-align.
3) Intermediate region: - outside PASS but not severe enough for DONT_CONSUME => DTX_ZEROS: the block emits zeros for the slot. If "DTX consumes input" is True, input is also consumed.
Hysteresis: "Hysteresis slots" controls how many slots in the same direction are required to consolidate a change of decision, avoiding fast flapping between states.
CONTROL PORT "ctrl" (MOD):
At initialization, and whenever "Guard initial (s)" or "Lead ahead (s)" are changed via callbacks, the block publishes a PMT dict on port "ctrl":
{ "t0_usrp": usrp_now + Guard initial (s), "lead_s": Lead ahead (s) }
This dict is intended to be connected to the "ctrl" port of the burst_time_tagger_cc block, so that the time tags (tx_time, tx_sob, tx_eob) are scheduled sufficiently in the future with respect to the real USRP clock, taking into account the host/USRP drift and the guard you choose.
The "stats" message port publishes, once per slot, a PMT dict:
{ "slot_idx": integer slot index inside the work call, "offset_s": last measured offset (usrp - host), "jitter_s": sliding-window jitter of the offset, "decision": 0=PASS, 1=DTX_ZEROS, 2=DONT_CONSUME, "host_s": host time (seconds), "usrp_s": USRP time (seconds) }
